name: Shinohara Kousuke
source: Kousuke had to move to the United States for treatment for his illness but before he left he confess his love for his teacher Chiaki but was turn down and found out Chiaki was getting married due to a arranged marriage. mouths later returns to Japan to finish his third year of high school.
